lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is a time of rebellion. A scattered alliance of worlds has struck the first blow against the Empire that rules the stars.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the confusion of that battle, rebel agents seized the plans for the Emperor’s newest weapon: a battle station the size of a moon, built to break planets whole.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hunted across the dark, Princess Leia runs for home with the stolen plans, and with the last hope of a galaxy in chains.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Above the burnt orange deserts of Tatooine, a rebel corvette ran with its engines wide open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And behind it came a shadow with no end: an Imperial destroyer, a wedge of grey brick a mile from nose to tail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her shields buckled. Her engines went dark. And the great ship swallowed her whole.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The rebels braced in the corridor, blasters up, counting the seconds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The door came apart in a hail of bricks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the shooting stopped, the smoke parted, and something tall and black stepped through it.

lines.speaker: vader
lines.text: The plans are aboard this ship. Tear her apart, stud by stud, until you find them.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deep in the hold, the Princess knelt beside a small blue and white astromech.

lines.speaker: leia
lines.text: Everything the Alliance needs is inside you now. Do not stop for anyone.

lines.speaker: threepio
lines.text: Oh, we are doomed. Absolutely, comprehensively doomed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An escape pod fell away from the captured ship, carrying two droids and the fate of the galaxy.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Hold your fire. There are no life forms aboard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They came down in the dunes of Tatooine, under two suns that never quite set together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sandcrawler took them in, and traded them away, to a moisture farm at the edge of nowhere.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And there a farm boy named Luke found a message hidden in the little droid’s memory.

lines.speaker: leia
lines.text: This recording is our last hope. Please. Help us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That evening he watched two suns go down, and knew that he could not stay.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stolen plans showed a single flaw: a thermal exhaust port, two metres wide, running straight down to the reactor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thirty small ships launched against a moon of grey brick. Very few of them would come back.

lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Cut the chatter, Red Squadron. Lock S-foils in attack position.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They dropped into the trench with the walls a grey blur on either side.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind them came the black fighter and its two escorts, and one by one the rebels fell.

lines.speaker: vader
lines.text: The Force is strong with this one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the last moment the boy switched off his targeting computer, closed his eyes, and listened.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Let go, Luke. Trust yourself.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two torpedoes went down the shaft. The station lit up from the inside...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: and came apart into ten thousand pieces.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They gave out medals in a hall of white brick, and for one bright afternoon the galaxy belonged to the people who had saved it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every last one of them built from two by four bricks, and a little bit of hope.
